headline: Revenue growth masked by restructuring-driven net loss
summary_short: Pinterest's Q1 FY2026 revenue grew 17.8% y/y to $1,007.5 million on 11% MAU growth and 6% ARPU growth, but a $47.1 million restructuring charge and higher share-based compensation drove a $73.6 million net loss versus $8.9 million net income a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 17.8% y/y (15% constant currency) to $1,007.5 million on 11% MAU growth and 6% ARPU growth; ad volume rose 24% while price per ad fell 5%. Cost of revenue grew 19.7% on higher engagement. Operating loss widened to $80.3 million on a $47.1 million Q1 restructuring charge (of an expected $59.6-69.6 million total, tied to a January workforce reduction and AI reorganization) plus $44.0 million higher share-based compensation. Net loss was $73.6 million versus net income a year ago. Equity fell to $2,850.6 million funding a $1.0 billion ASR and $493.0 million of buybacks, partly via a new $1.0 billion convertible note to Elliott. No forward guidance was stated.
